basic_details.scholarship_name: NYCU International Graduate Scholarship (National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University)
basic_details.offering_entity: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU) & Ministry of Education (MOE) Taiwan
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: NYCU Hsinchu Guangfu & Chiaotung Campuses (Hsinchu Science Park, Taiwan)
basic_details.major_restrictions: College of Computer Science, College of Electrical and Computer Engineering, College of Artificial Intelligence, and International Graduate Program in Semiconductor & Computing.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~120 to 160 university scholarships (full tuition waivers + monthly stipends) awarded annually to international graduate students
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global merit competition; Pakistani students represent a prominent cohort in semiconductor and CS departments (~15 to 25 awardees annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for Master's; up to 4 years for PhD, renewed annually subject to satisfactory academic standing

eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for MS; research Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or related STEM discipline from an HEC-recognized university with strong academic standing (minimum 75% aggregate or CGPA 3.20 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.50+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum requirement is 70% or 3.0/4.0; College of Computer Science admits typically have 3.40+ on a 4.0 scale.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Coursework in data structures, algorithms, computer architecture, operating systems, and discrete mathematics.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Final-year undergraduate or master's students can apply conditionally; degree completion certificate required before enrollment.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; software development, FPGA/VLSI design, or machine learning projects strongly valued.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic min 6.0, TOEFL iBT min 79, TOEIC min 750, or Duolingo min 105. Institutional Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from Pakistani universities is officially accepted.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; College of Computer Science international graduate programmes are taught 100% in English. Free Chinese language courses provided.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants apply for the scholarship simultaneously on the online admissions portal.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another Taiwan government scholarship (e.g. Taiwan MOE Scholarship) simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition fee waiver covering 100% of university tuition and credit fees (~NTD 120,000 to NTD 150,000 / year value; ~USD 4,000 to 5,000).

admission_application_fee.details: NYCU online application fee of NTD 2,000 (~USD 65) paid online via credit card.

accommodation.details: Subsidized on-campus graduate dormitories at Guangfu campus (Dorm 13, Graduate Dorm) guaranteed for international students; rent averages NTD 2,500 to 4,500/month (~USD 80 to 145/month).

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend: Master's students receive NTD 8,000 to NTD 15,000 / month (~USD 260 to 485 / month; ~PKR 70,000 to 132,000 / month); PhD students receive NTD 22,000 to NTD 32,000 / month (~USD 700 to 1,030 / month; ~PKR 193,000 to 281,000 / month) combining university scholarship and lab advisor top-ups.

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Taipei Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: Taiwan Resident Visa fee of USD 66 paid at Taipei Economic and Cultural Center (TECO) in Dubai/Muscat/Islamabad jurisdiction.

health_insurance.details: After 6 months of continuous residence, students are enrolled in Taiwan's world-renowned National Health Insurance (NHI) program for approx. NTD 826/month (often covered or subsidized by lab).

food_allowance.details: Meals at NYCU campus dining halls and Hsinchu night markets cost only NTD 70 to 120 per meal; easily covered by stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to NYCU Computing Center, AI supercomputers, cleanroom facilities, and laboratory equipment in Hsinchu Science Park.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: National Science and Technology Council (NSTC) travel grants cover international conference travel for students presenting papers.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to NTD 50,000 per conference presentation

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free NYCU campus shuttle buses connecting Guangfu and Boai campuses; Hsinchu City bus discounts with Taiwan EasyCard.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single premier Taiwanese technological university: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU, Hsinchu, Taiwan)
participating_institutions: College of Electrical and Computer Engineering
Hsinchu Science Park (adjacent semiconductor hub - TSMC, MediaTek)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 50 global university in Computer Science & Engineering (QS Subject CS #48, QS World #219); the intellectual engine of Taiwan's semiconductor miracle and home to TSMC/MediaTek research labs.
available_majors: MS / PhD in Computer Science and Engineering
MS / PhD in Data Science and Engineering
MS / PhD in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (International Graduate Program)
university_and_program_options.program_duration: MS: 2 years; PhD: 3 to 4 years full-time.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: 4-year BS (for MS) or MS (for PhD) in CS/STEM with 3.2+ GPA, transcripts, CV, study plan, 2 recommendation letters, and English proficiency (IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 79 / MOI accepted).
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Artificial Intelligence and Data Science attract intense applicant interest; Network Engineering, Information Security, and Computer Science & Engineering offer slightly higher admission rates.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Prospective applicants can contact professors in the College of Computer Science beforehand; obtaining informal supervisory agreement ensures immediate lab placement and additional lab research assistantship (RA) funding.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: NYCU Online International Student Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the NYCU OIA application portal, select semester intake (Fall or Spring), choose up to 3 graduate programmes, tick the scholarship application checkbox, and upload required documents.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (December - February for Fall / August - September for Spring): Check College of Computer Science lab websites and contact potential advisors.
Step 2 (Online portal): Create account on the NYCU International Student Admissions System.
Step 3 (Scholarship opt-in): On the application form, tick 'Yes' to apply for the NYCU International Student Scholarship.
Step 4 (Upload documents): Upload PDF scans of transcripts, degree certificates, study plan, CV, and English certificate / MOI letter.
Step 5 (Referees): Enter email contacts for 2 academic referees; system automatically emails recommendation requests.
Step 6 (By deadline): Pay NTD 2,000 application fee online and submit.
Step 7 (April - May for Fall): College of Computer Science reviews dossiers and announces admission and scholarship results simultaneously.
Step 8 (May - July): Formally confirm acceptance, receive official admission packet, and apply for Taiwan Resident Visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic application: The scholarship application is processed simultaneously with the admission application through the same portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two academic recommendation letters uploaded directly by referees via automated email links generated by the portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Study Plan / Statement of Purpose: (1) Motivations for choosing NYCU and College of Computer Science, (2) Previous academic and research background, (3) Proposed study schedule and research goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: 1 to 2 page study plan / research outline detailing research topics of interest and relevant lab alignment.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: 1 to 2 page academic CV detailing education, technical competencies, programming skills, capstone projects, and academic honors.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Some faculty lab PIs may conduct a 20-30 minute virtual technical interview via Google Meet to evaluate coding skills and research background.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.0+), TOEFL iBT (79+), Duolingo (105+), or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate. GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified scans uploaded with application; official degree certificates verified by TECO upon arrival.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations required for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the NYCU International Student Admissions System.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned color copy of original degree certificate and official English translation.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani applicants submit 4-year BS (for MS) or MS (for PhD); HEC attestation recommended.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete consolidated semester transcripts detailing all completed course units, grades, and grading scale.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure transcript clearly states credit hours and grading scale (CGPA out of 4.0).

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1-2 page essay articulating academic background, research interests, and study plan at NYCU.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight alignment with Hsinchu Science Park technologies and target NYCU computing labs.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1 to 2 page CV detailing academic background, programming proficiencies, capstone projects, and distinctions.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clearly link GitHub repositories, hackathons, and published work.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Two academic reference letters from university professors assessing analytical and intellectual capacity.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Referees must submit from institutional email addresses (.edu.pk).

required_documents_checklist.document_name: English Proficiency Certificate or MOI Letter
required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS (6.0+), TOEFL (79+), Duolingo (105+), or official Medium of Instruction (MOI) letter from university registrar.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Official English MOI letter from Pakistani university registrar is accepted by NYCU.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color copy of valid international passport bio-data page.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure passport is valid for at least 2 years beyond intended arrival.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Two admissions cycles per year: Fall intake (September start, deadline mid-March) and Spring intake (February start, deadline late September).

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 40% (Academic record, undergraduate/master's GPA, performance in core computing coursework)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 25% (Quality of final year project, thesis, technical publications, lab experience)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 15% (Quality of study plan and alignment with faculty research)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: Qualifying factor (virtual lab interview with prospective advisor)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: College of Computer Science Admissions Committee and Office of International Affairs Scholarship Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-stage evaluation: Faculty committees evaluate candidate dossiers on academic record, research capability, and study plan. Top candidates are recommended for university full tuition waivers and monthly stipends.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: 2,000+ international graduate applicants across NYCU engineering colleges
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~10% to 15% among qualified Pakistani STEM applicants
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Undergraduate degree in CS/EE/SE from recognized Pakistani university (FAST, NUST, UET, GIKI, COMSATS), strong programming skills, solid study plan, MOI or IELTS 6.5+.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of NUST, FAST-NUCES, UET Lahore/Taxila, GIKI, and COMSATS.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: India, Pakistan, Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand, Russia

fake_websites_and_scams: Unauthorized recruiters advertising guaranteed admission or scholarships in Taiwan for exorbitant fees. NYCU applications are processed strictly via oia.nycu.edu.tw.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: NYCU application fee is NTD 2,000 (~USD 65) paid online directly to the university. Never pay fees to external agents.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: NYCU does not use commercial recruitment agencies. Direct personal application is mandatory.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Flight ticket from Pakistan to Taipei: ~PKR 220,000 to 350,000.
First month's dorm deposit and living costs: ~NTD 10,000 (~PKR 88,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: You must speak fluent Mandarin Chinese. (FACT: 100% of graduate computing courses and research at NYCU are in English).
CLAIM: You must take IELTS or TOEFL. (FACT: NYCU officially accepts English Medium of Instruction certificates from Pakistani universities).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some student forums claim that Master's students do not receive stipends. In reality, most admitted international MS students receive a full tuition waiver plus a monthly living stipend (NTD 8,000 - 15,000/mo).

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain cumulative GPA of 3.00 / 4.30 or higher (approx. 75%) each semester to retain the scholarship for subsequent terms.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research enrollment on campus in Hsinchu.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-by-semester credit completion and GPA verification by the Office of International Affairs.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: International students holding an Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) can apply for a work permit permitting up to 20 hours per week of part-time work during semesters and full-time during holidays.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. International graduates qualify for a 1 to 2-year job search extension on their ARC in Taiwan, and Taiwan provides favorable work permits (Gold Card / points system) for high-tech talent.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: No clawback of previously awarded funds; GPA falling below 3.0 results in suspension of stipend for next semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing department requires formal approval from both departments.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Master's scholarship capped at 2 years; PhD scholarship capped at 4 years. Lab advisor funding can continue beyond.
